Step 3 — Verify consistency and no-inference rule
- Check arithmetic: 1.969,46 (net) + 393,89 (VAT) = 2.363,35 (grand total) — matches displayed total; consistent.
- Ensure values preserved with same decimals and without currency symbol (as required).
- Ensure Vat.Rate returned without "%" and with same decimal format "20,00".
- Sender VAT ID exactly as printed: "ATU18804300".
- Invoice.Date chosen as AR-Datum "23.10.2023" (explicit invoice date). Do not infer or replace with Leistungsdatum.

Step 4 — Final mapping readiness
- Map fields to schema with exact extracted values:
  - Invoice.Date -> "23.10.2023"
  - Sender.VatId -> "ATU18804300"
  - GrandTotal.Amount -> 2363,35 (numeric with same decimals)
  - Net.Amount -> 1969,46
  - Vat.Amount -> 393,89

No other alternatives override these choices; all values are explicitly present in the document and arithmetic is consistent.
